description: An independent family on an infinite carrier gives an injective assignment of nonprincipal ultrafilter extensions to its Boolean side assignments.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.assignment_ultrafilter_injection.{u} {α : Type u} [Infinite α]
  (A : Set (Set α)) (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.IsIndependent A) :
  ∃ f,
    Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ (ε : ↑A → Bool), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.sideChoices A ε ⊆ (↑↑(f ε)).sets
